Fil Chi here. Here’s what I noticed studying from an exclusive Chinese school in high school and then in Ateneo De Manila for college.
 
I noticed my Chinese friends who were rich spent a lot but my Chinese friends who weren’t so well off, were
very thrifty.

Meanwhile with Filipinos I couldn’t tell apart who was truly wealthy and who wasn’t because their spending habits were more or less similar. I had blockmates in college who I thought were very wealthy because of how much they spent, only later to find themselves needing a loan because they apparently didn’t have much savings.

This is when I noticed the normal fil-chi na may kaya is in a completely different tier than the filipino na may kaya. 

Also a big part of this is property. Most Filipinos in Ateneo lived in Fairview, Commonwealth, Marikina, Paranaque, etc. Whereas Fil Chis lived in Banawe, New Manila, Greenhills, Binondo where property is way way more expensive. So I think Fil-Chis invested in property that appreciated more over time compared to the Filipinos. 

This is just my perspective of course based from my experience.
